description: Adds the bounded recovery procedure for a Codex permission profile whose Meridian ownership markers were damaged by a host rewrite.
delta: Both workflows now state that `meridian codex configure --check` reports a named `repair-required` state when the effective profile is identical and only Meridian's ownership markers are damaged, that the printed diff must be reviewed and `--apply` confirmed explicitly, that any divergent profile stays BLOCKED with the diverging fields named, and that repair never proves a running session loaded the profile.
verification: upgrade from codex-worktree-access v1 installs the recovery paragraph in both Lean Delivery and Governed SDD while preserving consumer-owned text
repair tests cover the observed Codex app rewrite, damaged marker shapes, idempotence, exclusive private backups, and blocked divergent profiles
python3 scripts/check_repository.py and python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v pass
